page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Handwriting at top right and a stroke mark beside the text are not printed. Small marks "«" stand at the right edge of several lines. Catchword "ro" at the bottom right.

main_text.l: ber est, quippe quem pro libe

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. Handwriting at top right of the page (not printed) is excluded. The small "«" marks at line ends in the right margin are kept inline as printed; they may be line-end quotation signs. The word "exemplum" is split across lines without a printed hyphen and is written whole. "celarunt" and "cognita" are split without a printed hyphen and are written whole. "Hęc" is uncertain: the first letter could be H with a cedilla-like mark, so it is marked [?]. "tentio" is uncertain and marked [?]; the printed word may be a damaged "contentio". The "ꝑ" and other abbreviations are as printed. The paragraph is treated as continuing from the previous page, since the first line starts flush. The text ends on the half-word "libe" with the catchword "ro" below.
